symptom: Exporting a project to MDL takes hours — a sweep of `describe` statements, or `describe module <M> with all`, that is fast on a small app and unusable on a large one. Time scales with the size of the **project**, not with how many documents you asked for: 25 microflows and 100 microflows both cost ~1.1s *each*
cause: Every describe handler resolved its target by `ctx.Backend.List<Type>()` + linear scan. `List*` is not an index read — it BSON-decodes every unit of that `$Type` and converts each to the semantic model — so N describes cost N full decodes of the type. Quadratic, for a job whose minimum is one decode per document
insight: **Which fix applies depends on the weight of the type's gen→model conversion, not on the document count.** *Header* types (pages, enums, layouts, constants, Java actions) keep only identity and a few fields — measured, they all peak at the same ~340MB as the bare unit cache — so memoize the decoded list, cleared by the reader's existing `InvalidateCache`. *Flow* types (Microflow/Nanoflow/Rule) keep the entire flow (**+554MB** for 10k microflows), so resolve one at a time through the header index instead. **Two rules gate the memo**: read-only callers only (a shared element mutated in place — as `move_view_write.go`'s OQL rewrite does — poisons it), and never for a heavy type. **Derive the `$Type` from the codec registry, not from an alias table**: `rawUnitBSONType` covers ~12 types, `bsonTypeName[T]()` covers all ~40 and cannot drift. **Look for the second decode hiding inside the handler** — `resolveLayoutName` re-listed every layout once per page described. **Assert the call count, not the output**: correct output proves nothing about how many times the type was decoded, and the controls (stub the memo → 3 calls not 1; break `InvalidateCache` → stale read) are what prove the test detects anything. Verified byte-identical output vs. pre-fix across 9,999 microflows, 778 pages, 282 enumerations and a whole module. `MXCLI_NO_DECODE_CACHE=1` disables the memo. Tests `modelsdk/mprread/generic_byname_test.go`, `mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_layoutcache_test.go`. docs-site/src/internals/document-lookup.md
